name: fft3d_c2r_halfspec_f32
description: Batch-of-1 inverse 3D transform of a packed Hermitian half-spectrum. Input is interleaved float32 [nz, ny, nf, 2] (nf = nx//2 + 1, x-row stride exactly nf, no even-row padding), interpreted with the cuFFT C2R / torch.fft.irfftn convention. Output is the real-space float32 grid [nz, ny, nx], unnormalized (forward+inverse round-trip scales by N = nz*ny*nx). Companion of fft3d_r2c_halfspec_f32.
reference:
# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
import torch


def run(input):
    """Inverse of the packed half-spectrum 3D transform, unnormalized.

    input:  float32 [nz, ny, nx//2+1, 2] interleaved (re, im), the packed
            Hermitian half-spectrum produced by the forward transform.
    return: float32 [nz, ny, nx] real-space tensor, unnormalized
            (forward then inverse scales energy by N = nz*ny*nx).

    The transform convention matches cuFFT C2R and torch.fft.irfftn: the
    array is interpreted as the k_x >= 0 half of a Hermitian spectrum and
    implicitly completed; the imaginary parts of the k_x = 0 and (where
    present) k_x = Nyquist planes are ignored.
    """
    z = torch.view_as_complex(input.to(torch.float64))
    nz, ny, nf = z.shape
    out = torch.fft.irfftn(z, s=(nz, ny, 2 * (nf - 1)), norm="forward")
    return out.to(torch.float32)
